notes.title: We Are Participating In The Upcoming Steam Scream Fest!
notes.content:

Try to survive in the haunted castle!

[h3]What to expect[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Up to 4 people online co-op (1-4)
[*] A cool ghost to guide you around the castle
[*] New rooms

[/olist]

Be ready for a new experience!

notes.title: New Beta Incoming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42888589/0d573c13981bef984627f9c58dcaae39da3bd90d.png[/img]
We are very excited to announce the spetember Beta, registration is now available on our new website!
Sign up here : https://angel-games-studio.web.app/


What to expect:
A cool ghost to guide you around the castle
Killing cool monsters
Jump scare
Traps
Goofy encounters
Up to 4 people online co-op (1-4)
Random rooms (updated according to the number of participants)
3 mini bosses (Troll, Spider Queen And Medusa)!
Fight the demon that haunts the castle

Sign up now!

notes.title: The Beta Continues!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42888589/08d673f9039d8f705a7d8b4ab333664cd78b3afd.png[/img]
[h1]The beta continues until june![/h1]
Registration is still available!
Sign up here : https://angel-games-studio.web.app/

[h2]What did we insert in the first few weeks:[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Procedural Recoil system!
[*] Melee combat system

[*] New enemy animations
[/olist]
[h2]What to expect in the next few weeks[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Spider enemy shooting webs
[*] Spider enemy walking on the walls and ceiling
[*] New rooms to explore
[*] New demon (boss) skills and vfx
[/olist]

Sign up now!
